body:
DELIVERED + codex-verified (two rounds). Commits 8441ed1f + 7a43eaa6.
AC-TXN-5 (hybrid-strict) and AC-TXN-5A (hybrid-async) invariants are now swept across the real numeric E3
commit-latency bounds [1,5,20,100] ms with a real spawn_latency_flusher (bound threaded through via _at
constructors + SWEEP_TARGET_BYTES, NOT the old pinned SegmentConfig::new(1,1)), each with a per-bound
flusher-liveness proof (segments_sealed advances only via the flusher; no-flusher control parked), and asserted
BYTE-IDENTICAL across all bounds.

Swept facets (byte-identical across bounds):
- AC-TXN-5 strict-cut unknown-outcome request_id replay; AC-TXN-5A success barrier — recorded honestly as
  FORCE-SEALED paths (request_id-bearing commits force-seal synchronously via gc_force_seal, so the latency
  window cannot shift their timing → config-independent BY CONSTRUCTION; not claimed as "tested through a window").
- AC-TXN-5A hard-debt admission under a below-threshold latency window (flusher-sealed co-buffering pushes accrue
  real deferred-checkpoint debt to the hard budget; admission fails closed).
- AC-TXN-5A async-apply checkpoint drain + DuringAsyncSqliteApply fault (driven on the bound-threaded composed
  backend, not the standalone projection — codex round-1 fix).
- AC-TXN-5A high-water withholding, retention advancement, and id-safety no-resurrection — now genuinely swept
  (codex round-2 fix; the round-1 N/A was a dodge), proven byte-identical across bounds on durable observables.

Honest structural facts recorded (not blanket "no gap"):
- Windowed unknown-outcome: every unknown-outcome/replay contract in this engine is request_id-bearing, and
  request_id-bearing commits FORCE-SEAL, so no below-threshold-window replay variant exists by construction. The
  only genuinely latency-windowed path is a plain co-buffering push (no request_id → no exactly-once replay
  contract); its durability+visibility is swept (liveness + AC-TXN-1 in the parent sweep).
- The single remaining capability-N/A is genuinely STRUCTURAL: the AC-TXN-5A ordered-batch EXACT high-water
  CommandPosition identity (recovery_high_water == (shard,0,2)) is a standalone-HybridProjectionStore assertion
  over HAND-CONSTRUCTED CommandPositions (not seal-minted), so it has no commit-latency knob; its drain-exactly-once
  ESSENCE is swept on the composed backend.
- AC-TXN-4 capability-N/A (object-log-substrate-internal crash-point matrix, bound-independent).

Codex adversarial review (2 rounds): bound-threading + byte-identical assertion SOUND; round-1 flagged the
high-water/retention/id-safety N/A as a dodge and the force-seal framing as an overclaim — BOTH fixed in
7a43eaa6 (facets genuinely swept; force-seal recorded as a structural fact).
Verify (independent, 0-failed): cargo test -p pqueue-conformance ac_txn_7_invariants_unchanged_across_latency_sweep
-> 1 passed; full -p pqueue-conformance -> 87 passed, 0 failed; fmt clean; clippy -D warnings PASS.
AC-TXN-7 evidence row: PASS, 0 GAP, 32 assertions. (The separate AC-TXN-5A row keeps its pre-existing,
out-of-scope segment-object-reclamation partial — tracked in pqueue-b5cc2bc7.)
summary: AC-TXN-5/5A swept byte-identical across numeric E3 bounds [1/5/20/100ms] with real flusher; force-seal framed as structural fact; sole N/A genuinely structural; codex-verified 2 rounds; row pass
